title: 第十七回 鬼影合灵第十八回 慕府结亲
slug: 驭音心经第七十回狼心逞乱
lines: 第十七回鬼影合灵
容月一家居住在船屋之上，孤鹤雁不方便久留，闻听神望坡明珠的传奇故事，孤鹤雁心生好奇，便欲去神望坡看上一看，同时看一下是否能再找到慕府，见一下慕府老君和卉云。
容月两次与他机缘巧遇，早已是情愫萌动，心生爱意，便决意随他一同前往。
容月父亲闻知，却是眉头紧锁，忧心忡忡：“容月，你一个女儿家，跟着他远行，成何体统？”
容月眼中闪烁着一股子坚定：“爹，我就是想出去见识一下世面，我不想一生只待在船屋。”
“哎，那要是出了事，该怎么办？”
容月父亲叹息。
“不会出事的，他是个仙人，能保护我的安全。”
容月闻听轻松一笑。
容月父亲无可奈何，深叹口气：“那好吧，只希望你到葫芦潭看一下，便就赶快回来。”
望着两个年轻人渐去的背影，容月父亲心中默默叹息，他早知女儿有一天会离开自己，但他未料到，这一天会来得这么早，这么快，让他难以割舍，又让他心头隐痛。
容月心中却是满心欢喜，她感觉命运之线将她与孤鹤雁两个紧紧牵在一起。
阳光倾洒在她的脸上，她的心情如同出笼的小鸟一样，欢心雀跃。
沿途看见漂亮的花儿，容月便高兴的去采，左掐一枝，又折一支，嘴上还不停的与孤鹤雁耍贫嘴。
“路上要是遇见妖怪，你要帮我打他！”
容月调皮地说。
孤鹤雁抱着她采到的花，连声应诺：“嗯嗯，好的，好的，没问题。”
“路上要是遇见坏人，你也要帮我打他！
‘容月继续逗他。
“嗯嗯，好的，好的，没问题。”
孤鹤雁闻听，仍是连声应诺。
孤鹤雁未曾想到，容月竟能毅然决定与他同行，这让他心中充满无尽的爱意。
孤鹤雁第一眼初见容月，便有一种极想亲近依偎之感，他如何不珍惜爱捧这份天赐的缘分。
“路上要是遇见别的女人，你不能跟她搭话。”
“这个怎么啦，你不答应？”
“我不是不答应，我只是觉得，这个……应该看情况。”
“不能看情况，你不应该随便和别的女人搭话，特别是没有我的允许。”
容月闻听，故作一脸嗔怒。
“可是，要是遇见我妈呐？”
孤鹤雁闻听，故作一脸纳闷。
“遇见你妈？你不是说你是个孤儿吗？你不是说你被人捡回来的吗？”
容月闻听，禁不住一连三问。
“啊，是啊。”
“我是个孤儿啊，可是我觉得……，可能会有……这种情况。”
“应该看情况吧。”
孤鹤雁说着，晃着脑袋，故作一脸认真严肃状。
content_en:
Chapter 17: Ghost Shadows and Spirits Together
Rongyue's family lived on a houseboat, and it was inconvenient for Gu Heyan to stay for a long time. Hearing the legendary story of the Shenwangpo Pearl, Gu Heyan became curious and wanted to go to Shenwangpo to have a look. At the same time, he wanted to see if he could find Mu Mansion again and meet Mr. Mu Mansion and Huiyun.
Rong Yue met him twice by chance, and she was already attracted to him and fell in love with him, so she decided to go with him.
When Rong Yue's father heard about it, his brows furrowed and he was worried: "Rong Yue, how would it be for a daughter of yours to travel far away with him?"
Rong Yue's eyes flashed with determination: "Dad, I just want to go out and see the world. I don't want to just stay in the houseboat my whole life."
"Hey, what should we do if something happens?"
Rong Yue's father sighed.
"Nothing will happen. He is an immortal and can protect my safety."
Rong Yue smiled relaxedly upon hearing this.
Rong Yue's father was helpless and sighed deeply: "Well, I just want you to go to Hulutan for a visit and then come back as soon as possible."
Looking at the disappearing figures of the two young people, Rong Yue's father sighed silently in his heart. He had known that his daughter would leave him one day, but he did not expect that this day would come so early and so quickly, which made it difficult for him to let go and made his heart aching.
Rong Yue's heart was filled with joy. She felt that the thread of fate tightly linked her and Gu Heyan.
The sun was shining on her face, and she was as happy as a bird out of its cage.
Seeing beautiful flowers along the way, Rong Yue went to pick them happily, pinching one branch and then another, while she kept talking nonsense with Gu Heyan.
"If I encounter a monster on the road, you have to help me beat him!"
Rong Yue said mischievously.
Gu Heyan hugged the flowers she picked and promised repeatedly: "Yeah, okay, okay, no problem."
"If I meet a bad guy on the road, you have to help me beat him up!
‘Rong Yue continued to tease him.
“Yeah, okay, okay, no problem. "
Gu Heyan heard this and kept saying yes.
Gu Heyan never thought that Rong Yue would resolutely decide to go with him, which filled his heart with endless love.
When Gu Heyan saw Rong Yue for the first time, he felt like he wanted to get close and cuddle up. How could he not cherish this God-given fate of loving and praising her.
"If you meet another woman on the road, you can't talk to her. "
"Ah, this..."
"What's wrong with this, you don't agree? "
"It's not that I don't agree, I just think that... it should depend on the situation. "
"It doesn't depend on the situation. You shouldn't talk to other women casually, especially without my permission. "
Rong Yue heard this and pretended to be angry.
"But what if I meet my mother? "
Gu Heyan heard this and pretended to be puzzled.
"Meet your mother? Didn't you say you were an orphan? Didn’t you say you were picked up? "
Rong Yue heard this and couldn't help but ask three questions in a row.
"Ah, yes. "
"I am an orphan, but I think... there may be... such a situation. "
“It should depend on the situation. "
Gu Heyan said, shaking his head, pretending to be serious.
